register_trainer_factory: register the trainer factory and related services into a fairseq2 dependency container
create_trainer: create a fairseq2 Trainer instance wired through the dependency container with custom kwargs
create_validator: create a StandardValidator instance wired through the dependency container for model validation
create_fp16_loss_scaler: create a Float16LossScaler for mixed precision training via the dependency container
create_huggingface_exporter: create an OutOfProcHuggingFaceExporter to export model checkpoints to Hugging Face format
